title: Multilingual Learning Support Platform
tooltipContent: App may take over 30 seconds to load on first visit.
description: A full-stack web application built with a team to support dementia prevention programs. It provides registration, AI-powered self-study tools for math and reading exercises, Japanese and English localization, and real-time in-app notifications.
descriptionContinued: On the admin side, I created a management interface that allows admins to generate course materials using AI in PDF format, as well as a dashboard where they can efficiently manage users, staff, courses, and rooms.
myRoleDescription: As a Full-Stack Web Developer, I designed and implemented the platform's key AI-assisted learning and course-material workflows.
aiPoweredSelfStudyDesc: Developed an interactive learning feature that enables seniors to practice basic and intermediate-level math and reading exercises using AI.
automatedCourseMaterialDesc: Implemented a system that allows administrators and staff to generate course materials in PDF format, aligned with the same difficulty levels as the self-study module.
adminManagementSystemDesc: Built CRUD functionality for managing participants and staff, ensuring seamless administrative control over users and course management.
appWalkthroughDescription: Watch how seniors can practice math and reading exercises interactively with AI-generated content.
